messages.body: The Final level calls for patience. Keep a steady plan and trust it.
Strategy and analysis are best learned by thinking, not rushing.
Take short breaks between long sessions. Your focus will last longer.
Case-style answers need practice. Write one in full today.
Prioritise the heavy papers and give them your best hours.
Mock tests under time reveal what to revise. Take one this week.
You are near the end of a demanding qualification. Well done so far.
The depth you have gained is real. Let it give you confidence.
Every paper you prepare is a story you can be proud of.
